# Högre lönsamhet för NCC – Bioarctics vd om det avslutade avtalet

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Stockholmsbörsen väntades öppna lägre efter att Nasdaq 100 gått in i en teknisk korrektion (ner över 10 % från toppen den 6 oktober), driven av oro för hur AI-investeringarna ska finansieras, samtidigt som USA höll mellanårsval. Gästerna Carl Hedberg (DNB Carnegie) och Niklas Lundin (Handelsbanken) såg oron som tillfällig, ville köpa nedgången i lönsamma AI-namn och sade att verkstadsbolag som Atlas Copco och ABB har fallit för mycket. Hedberg föredrar på längre sikt inhemska småbolag med starka balansräkningar. I rapportflödet steg NCC och Noba, medan RaySearch, Truecaller och BioArctic föll; BioArctic föll efter att Novartis avslutat licensavtalet i förtid.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Hedberg says the >6% fall on a strong report is too large, flow-driven, and a good entry point.

#### Reasoning

Guest Carl Hedberg (DNB Carnegie) says Atlas Copco's sharp drop after a very fine report was driven by flows rotating out of AI and data-centre winners, not by fundamentals. He sees the US AI worry as temporary and expects a short-term recovery for engineering names with that link.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI and data-centre worry proves long-lasting
- if order intake weakens in coming quarters
- if regulation hits the US data-centre build-out

> *"Så både Atlas och ABB som hade väldigt fina kvartalsrapporter men fick väldigt dåliga kursreaktioner tycker jag öppnar upp för intressanta lägen i det där."*

---

### 🟢 ABB — ABB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Hedberg: strong report but poor share reaction opens an interesting entry point.

#### Reasoning

Guest Hedberg groups ABB with Atlas Copco as quality engineering names punished by flow-driven selling of AI-linked stocks despite strong reports. He expects a short-term rebound as the AI worry fades.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI capex worry persists
- if the data-centre investment theme reverses

> *"Det tycker jag är för stor rörelse. Framför allt på en så pass bra rapport de levererar"*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lundin: about 12x next year's earnings, not expensive; stock-picking within AI is becoming more important.

#### Reasoning

Guest Niklas Lundin (Handelsbanken) says AI semiconductors have turned cheap after the sell-off, citing Nvidia at about 12x forward earnings. He favours profitable AI names, but notes that cheapness is partly cyclical and that capital raising and IPO supply weigh on the sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI financing concerns escalate
- if earnings revisions turn negative
- if the semiconductor cycle turns down

> *"Men Nvidia handlar nu på kanske 12 gånger nästa års vinst. Så det är inte så dyrt."*

---

### 🟡 NCC-B — NCC | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Better profitability, but use of sale proceeds unclear; Hedberg expects a wait-and-see stance until it is known.

#### Reasoning

NCC beat on adjusted EBIT, has strong cash flow and four straight quarters of good order intake. Guest Hedberg expects investors to wait until NCC decides between a big dividend and a large acquisition, which comes well into next year when the industry sale closes.

#### Sell Triggers

- if proceeds go to an expensive or poorly fitting acquisition
- if the industry sale is delayed or fails
- if construction margins weaken

> *"Och möjligtvis att det blir lite avvaktande fram tills dess att man vet om det är så. Om det blir en stor utdelning till aktieägarna eller om det blir ett större förvärv istället."*

---

### 🟠 VSURE — Verisure | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Operations deliver steadily, but the PE-owner overhang must clear before the stock works.

#### Reasoning

Guest Hedberg says Verisure keeps delivering stable quarters with an EBIT and margin beat. The share's weakness since listing is tied to the large private-equity owner's possible selling overhang, which needs to work its way out first.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the PE owner sells a large block
- if operational delivery weakens

> *"Så jag tror att det finns lite sådana saker som behöver verka ut innan den här aktien fullt ut fungerar."*

---

### 🟠 RAY-B — RaySearch | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Record sales but margin fell; Hedberg says the market wants proof of delivery before restoring confidence.

#### Reasoning

Hedberg notes uneven quarterly delivery and questions over AI competition. This report does not settle the uncertainty. He would like to see the full-year targets met before trusting the company again. Shares fell 13-14%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if full-year targets are missed
- if AI competition erodes the software business

> *"Men jag tror marknaden vill nog se att man faktiskt levererar på det innan man verkligen ger dem fullt förtroende igen."*

---

### 🟠 BIOA-B — BioArctic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Novartis deal terminated, reasons not technology-related. Hedberg: negative; risk of fewer near-term licence deals.

#### Reasoning

Hedberg calls the end of the Novartis deal negative news, since licence deals were a value driver beyond the Alzheimer drug. The CEO says the termination is unrelated to the BrainTransporter technology, four partnerships remain, and new updates are due in spring.

#### Sell Triggers

- if other partners end BrainTransporter deals
- if no new licence deals arrive

> *"Men det kommer ändå spekuleras i om det här kommer kunna göra att det blir färre sådana licensavtal i närtid med andra bolag."*
